supported_scope: Explicit linking of requirements, tasks, changes, and verification checkpoints via structured Implementation Plan artifacts and interactive artifact review
required_setup: Invoke /plan command to generate an Implementation Plan artifact; ensure workspace has test suites or instruct agent to write tests; configure artifact review policies as needed
constraints: User must review and approve the Implementation Plan artifact before execution
Verification requires local test suites or agent-generated tests
Artifact review policies can configure whether agent pauses for plan approval

evidence.quote: The agent drafts a structured Implementation Plan artifact with clear task breakdowns and verification checkpoints.
evidence.claim: Structured Implementation Plan artifacts explicitly link tasks and verification checkpoints to requirements.

evidence.quote: The agent generates an Implementation Plan artifact. User review and approval: The agent presents the plan artifact in the review pane.
evidence.claim: User can review and approve the plan artifact, enabling traceability from requirements to implementation.

evidence.section: CLI best practices > Establish verification loops
evidence.quote: Once the agent proposes code, instruct it to run the local test command to verify its work. Watch the agent execute the command and iterate on the test outputs automatically.
evidence.claim: Verification evidence is linked by running local tests after implementation.

evidence.quote: You can interact with the plan in several ways: Inline comments, Scope adjustments, Artifact review policies, Proceed to transition the agent into execution mode.
evidence.claim: Interactive artifact review and inline commenting support explicit linking and traceability.
